g.text: METEOROLOGICAL EDGE COMPUTING
Edge Meteorological Forecasting: Constraints & Dataset
Real-time 3-hour ahead surface temperature prediction for resource-constrained IoT weather stations
EDGE COMPUTING MOTIVATION & TRADEOFFS
The Telemetry Energy Bottleneck
• Remote edge weather stations operate on solar / battery budgets.
• Wireless RF transmission (Cellular / LoRa) burns 10x–100x more energy
per bit than local on-chip digital arithmetic.
• Cloud dependency introduces network latency, jitter, and outage risks.
On-Chip FPGA Inference Advantage
• Performs local predictive filtering at sub-milliwatt dynamic power.
• Deterministic cycle-level latency: results ready within microseconds.
• Transmit over RF only on severe micro-climate divergence / alerts.
TARGET FORECAST HORIZON SPECIFICATION
Target: Predict temperature 3 hours in advance:
T_hat(t+3)
• Horizon allows agricultural shade deployment and HVAC pre-cooling.
• System clock: 50.0 MHz | Processing latency: 5 clock cycles (100 ns!).
• Zero external DRAM requirement; internal logic registers store history.
Achieves full edge autonomy with zero cloud dependency.
DATASET PROFILE: NASA POWER SATELLITE API
Geographic & Climatic Parameters
• Target Location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (10.82°N, 106.63°E).
• Climate Zone: Tropical Monsoon (pronounced dry & wet rainy seasons).
• Telemetry: Hourly Surface Temperature at 2 Meters (T2M) in °C.
Chronological Partition & Scale
• Total Dataset Span: 5 Full Years (2021 – 2025), 43,800+ hourly points.
• Training Set: 2021–2023 (26,280 samples) for offline OLS fitting.
• Held-Out Test Set: 2024–2025 (17,520 samples) for hardware validation.
STATISTICAL DATA DISTRIBUTION & DYNAMICS
MIN / MAX RANGE
MEAN & STD DEV
Diurnal Dynamic:
Peak solar heating ~13:00; minimum ~05:00.
Monsoon Dynamic:
Afternoon rain drops temperature by 4°C–6°C in 2 hrs.
→ Rigorous testbed for testing both periodic and sudden thermal transients.
CE436 CAPSTONE
Forecast Horizon: 3 Hours Ahead | Latency: 5 Clock Cycles @ 50 MHz (100 ns) vs Multi-Second Cloud REST APIs
